mentions.name: echu
mentions.description: echu is a small app that turns long reads, books, and YouTube videos into short, readable cards, helping users digest saved content and clear their 'learn later' backlog.
mentions.problem: A years-old 'learn later' backlog of long reads, books, and YouTube videos is hard to process.
mentions.audience: Personal use (the author used it to clear a personal backlog).
mentions.source_excerpt: echu – a tiny app that turns long reads, books, and youtube videos into short, readable cards. helped me process my 3yo 'learn later' backlog in just one week.

evidence.value: echu – a tiny app that turns long reads, books, and youtube videos into short, readable cards. helped me process my 3yo 'learn later' backlog in just one week.
